meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以检查 claude-mem 的云端同步状态，或把 cmem.ai 给出的三项连接值（token、user id、SyncHub URL）写入本机设置，然后重启 worker 并验证是否连通。同步会把观察叙述和完整提示词文本上传到你的 cmem.ai 账户。
howto.when: 当你说出“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”“sync status”等说法，或想把记忆数据库备份、同步到 cmem.ai 账户时。

say.text: 看一下我的云同步状态
say.note: 报告设备 id、待同步数量和 Hub 是否可达

say.text: 帮我设置云同步，token、user id、SyncHub URL 我准备好了
say.note: 三项值写入本机设置，随后重启 worker

say.text: 重启 worker 并确认同步已连通
say.note: 每 5 秒轮询状态，直到 hub 可达

howto.what_en: Claude checks claude-mem cloud sync status or writes the token, user id, and Hub URL from cmem.ai into settings, then restarts the worker and verifies sync. Sync uploads observation narratives and full prompt text to your cmem.ai account.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "sync status", etc., or want your memory database backed up or synced to your cmem.ai account.

say_en.note: Reports device id, pending counts, Hub reachability, last flush

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync — here's my token, user id, and SyncHub URL
say_en.note: Writes the three values, then restarts the worker

say_en.text: Restart the worker and confirm sync is connected
say_en.note: Polls status until hub.reachable is true
